preconditions.message: Only a monitored network can be activated
Only an active network can be stabilized
Only an operational facility can be restricted
Only a restricted facility can be restored
Only a planned shipment can be dispatched
A delivered shipment cannot be delayed
Only an open inventory alert can be acknowledged
Only an escalated disruption can be contained
Only a contained disruption can be closed
Only a draft recovery plan can be approved
Only an approved recovery plan can be started
Only an active recovery plan can be completed
Only a pending decision can be approved
Only a pending decision can be rejected
Only a draft update can be published
